identificationModule.briefTitle: A Multicenter, Prospective, Phase II Study of Zanubrutinib for Maintenance in Patients With Mantle Cell Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Zanubrutinib for Maintenance Therapy in Patients With Mantle Cell Lymphoma Who Have Remission After First-line Immunochemotherapy- a Multicenter, Prospective, Phase II Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate whether maintenance therapy with Zanubrutinib monotherapy could improve the 2-year progression free survival (PFS) of patients with mantle cell lymphoma who had remission after first-line immunochemotherapy
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this study, patients diagnosed with mantle cell lymphoma who have achieved remission (CR or PR) by first-line immunochemotherapy, will be treated with Zanubrutinib monotherapy for 2 years (or until PD, intolerable toxicity, death, withdrawal, or study termination). This study aims to evaluate whether maintenance therapy with Zanubrutinib monotherapy could improve the 2-year progression free survival (PFS) of those patients, and explore the efficiency and safety.

interventions.name: Zanubrutinib
interventions.description: Patients diagnosed with mantle cell lymphoma who have achieved remission (CR or PR) by first-line immunochemotherapy, will be treated with Zanubrutinib monotherapy for 2 years (or until PD, intolerable toxicity, death, withdrawal, or study termination).

primaryOutcomes.description: the period from the date of patients sign informed consent to the observed progression of the disease or the occurrence of death for any reason
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: the period from the date of patients sign informed consent to the observed event for any reason
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of first documented event, progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: time between the date of patients sign informed consent and the date of death or the date of last follow-up time
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of death or the date of last follow-up time, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion, up to 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: evaluate patients' quality of life by questionnaire.

otherOutcomes.description: Biomarkers for predictive factors of efficacy at baseline or during the treatment
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Throughout the treatment period, up to 2 years
